ssh_password.name: Device SSH password
ssh_password.description: Stored in this Home Assistant app's configuration. Never included in the web interface or logs.

ssh_host_key.name: Verified SSH public host key
ssh_host_key.description: Key type followed by the complete public key. This is not a password.

refresh_seconds.name: Initial polling interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: Used until lighting settings are saved in the app. Use Lighting settings in the sidebar app to adjust polling and color refresh separately.

allow_led_control.name: Allow LED control
allow_led_control.description: Experimental. Keep off until you are ready to observe a ten-second test on the physical switch.
